data.gousto_methods: {"Spaghetti Bolognese":["Finely chop the onion, garlic and carrot.","Brown the beef mince in a little olive oil over a high heat, then add the veg and cook for 5 min.","Stir in the tomato paste, chopped tomatoes, crumbled stock cube, oregano and a splash of water. Simmer 20 min.","Meanwhile cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente, then drain.","Season the ragù and serve over the spaghetti."],"Chilli con Carne":["Chop the onion, garlic and pepper.","Brown the mince, then add the veg and spices and cook 5 min.","Add the tomato paste, chopped tomatoes and drained kidney beans. Simmer 25 min.","Cook the rice, then serve with the chilli."],"Chicken Fajitas":["Slice the chicken, peppers and onion.","Fry the chicken in olive oil over a high heat until golden.","Add the peppers, onion, garlic and fajita spice and cook 6-8 min until soft.","Warm the tortillas and serve with the chicken and peppers."],"Beef Curry":["Chop the onion, garlic and ginger.","Brown the beef, then add the onion, garlic and ginger and cook 5 min.","Stir in the curry paste, chopped tomatoes and coconut milk.
